en.main:
Melee/Glaive Melee Kills grant a stack of 'Warlord's Sigil'. Maximum of 10 stacks. Finishers grant 3 stacks (as soon as their animation starts). 

Warlord's Sigil stacks decay one at a time every 4.75 seconds.

Warlord's Sigil grants the following Melee Damage increases at 1|2|3|...|10 stacks:
67.5% | 122% | 166% | 202% | 228% | 249% | 265% | 278% | 289% | 300% Additional Base Melee Damage.


Reaching or refreshing the duration of the 10th stack grants 1 Melee Ability Charge and 'Warlord's Fury Ready' for 8 seconds. The 10th stack's duration cannot be refreshed by Finishers.

Using any Melee while Warlord's Fury Ready is active will grant 'Warlord's Fury' for 10 seconds, granting the following benefits:
• 400% Additional Base Melee Damage
• 20% decreased Melee Animation Duration
• 38.4x Melee ability regeneration speed

Warlord's Sigil's stack count is reset to 0 once Warlord's Fury ends. While Warlord's Fury is active, gaining stacks of Warlord's Sigil is not possible. 

Not triggering Warlord's Fury will return the buff to Warlord's Sigil x10.

en.main:
After not having exchanged damage for 1 second:
Grants 20 Handling, 40 Reload Speed, and 5% decreased Reload Animation Duration. Swords receive up to a 12.5% increase to Movement Speed instead.

After not having exchanged damage for 2 seconds:
Grants 20 Handling, 40 Reload Speed, and a 5% decresed Reload Duration. Swords receive up to a 25% increase to Movement Speed instead.

Can activate while stowed.

Exchanging damage refers to either dealing or receiving damage. Self-damage and environmental damage do not count.
